cases.name: packs: the 8 skills of contrib, quality, release and docs-audit exist, user-invoked, named after their folder, with an argument-hint
packs: each skill's description is one line of at most 250 characters
cases.cmd:
P="{{CLAUDE}}/../packs"; [ -d "$P/contrib" ] || { printf 'ok (skipped: no packs/contrib beside claude/ - a deployed workshop)'; exit 0; }; out=$(python3 -B - "$P" <<'PY'
import os, sys
P = sys.argv[1]
SKILLS = "contrib/claude/skills/contrib-issue contrib/claude/skills/contrib-validate contrib/claude/skills/contrib-pr quality/claude/skills/quality-report release/claude/skills/release-prepare release/claude/skills/release-evidence release/claude/skills/release-verify docs-audit/claude/skills/docs-audit".split()
def front(path):
    text = open(path, encoding="utf-8").read()
    assert text.startswith("---\n"), path
    head, body = text[4:].split("\n---\n", 1)
    return head.splitlines(), body

bad = []
for s in SKILLS:
    head, _ = front(os.path.join(P, s, "SKILL.md"))
    i = [n for n, l in enumerate(head) if l.startswith("description:")]
    if len(i) != 1: bad.append("none:" + s); continue
    value = head[i[0]].split(":", 1)[1].strip()
    nxt = head[i[0] + 1] if i[0] + 1 < len(head) else ""
    if value in ("", "|", ">", "|-", ">-") or nxt.startswith(" "): bad.append("multiline:" + s)
    if len(value.strip('"')) > 250: bad.append("long:%s=%d" % (s, len(value)))
print("bad=" + (",".join(bad) or "none"))
PY
); rc=$?; m=''; [ "$rc" = "0" ] || m="$m rc=$rc"; printf %s "$out" | grep -qF -- bad=none || m="$m missing:bad=none"; if [ -z "$m" ]; then printf ok; else printf 'MISMATCH%s\n%s' "$m" "$out"; fi

import os, sys

def front(path):

    assert text.startswith("---\n"), path
    head, body = text[4:].split("\n---\n", 1)

cases.name: repo-orkeon: repo.yaml parses and holds every key the generic skills name
cases.cmd:
P="{{CLAUDE}}/../packs"; [ -d "$P/contrib" ] || { printf 'ok (skipped: no packs/contrib beside claude/ - a deployed workshop)'; exit 0; }; python3 -c "import yaml" 2>/dev/null || { printf 'ok (skipped: PyYAML missing)'; exit 0; }; out=$(python3 -B - "$P" <<'PY'
import os, sys
P = sys.argv[1]
SKILLS = "contrib/claude/skills/contrib-issue contrib/claude/skills/contrib-validate contrib/claude/skills/contrib-pr quality/claude/skills/quality-report release/claude/skills/release-prepare release/claude/skills/release-evidence release/claude/skills/release-verify docs-audit/claude/skills/docs-audit".split()
def front(path):
    text = open(path, encoding="utf-8").read()
    assert text.startswith("---\n"), path
    head, body = text[4:].split("\n---\n", 1)
    return head.splitlines(), body
import re, yaml
d = yaml.safe_load(open(os.path.join(P, "repo-orkeon", "references", "repo.yaml"), encoding="utf-8"))
need = {"product", "origin", "commands.build", "commands.test", "commands.coverage", "commands.sonar",
        "commands.docs_checks", "commands.release_readiness", "contrib.branch", "contrib.commit",
        "contrib.issue_templates.bug", "contrib.pr_template", "contrib.checklist", "release.version_file",
        "release.tag", "release.changelog", "release.workflows.release", "release.workflows.verify",
        "release.windows_jobs", "release.channels"}
for s in SKILLS:
    _, body = front(os.path.join(P, s, "SKILL.md"))
    need |= set(re.findall(r"`((?:commands|contrib|release)\.[a-z_]+(?:\.[a-z_]+)?)`", body))
def get(key):
    v = d
    for part in key.split("."):
        if not isinstance(v, dict) or part not in v: return None
        v = v[part]
    return v
missing = sorted(k for k in need if get(k) in (None, "", []))
lists = [k for k in ("commands.docs_checks", "contrib.checklist", "release.windows_jobs", "release.channels") if not isinstance(get(k), list)]
chan = [c for c in (get("release.channels") or []) if not (isinstance(c, dict) and c.get("name") and c.get("check"))]
print("keys=%d missing=%s notlist=%s badchannel=%d" % (len(need), ",".join(missing) or "none", ",".join(lists) or "none", len(chan)))
PY
); rc=$?; m=''; [ "$rc" = "0" ] || m="$m rc=$rc"; printf %s "$out" | grep -qF -- 'missing=none notlist=none badchannel=0' || m="$m missing:missing=none notlist=none badchannel=0"; if [ -z "$m" ]; then printf ok; else printf 'MISMATCH%s\n%s' "$m" "$out"; fi

packs: a hand-over follows the source-space rule - a block with a handed-over command holds that one command, two or more are a script under .claude/local/scripts/, checked with bash -n, handed as bash <path>
cases.cmd:
P="{{CLAUDE}}/../packs"; [ -d "$P/contrib" ] || { printf 'ok (skipped: no packs/contrib beside claude/ - a deployed workshop)'; exit 0; }; out=$(python3 -B - "$P" <<'PY'
import os, re, sys
P = sys.argv[1]
OUT = re.compile(r"^\s*(git (add|commit|push|tag|switch)\b|gh (issue|pr) (create|comment|merge)\b|gh release (create|upload)\b|gh workflow run\b)")
bad, blocks, scripts = [], 0, 0
for d, _, fs in os.walk(P):
    for n in fs:
        if not n.endswith(".md"): continue
        path = os.path.join(d, n)
        text = open(path, encoding="utf-8").read()
        rel = os.path.relpath(path, P)
        for block in re.findall(r"^\s*```[a-z]*\n(.*?)^\s*```", text, re.S | re.M):
            lines = [l for l in block.splitlines() if l.strip() and not l.strip().startswith("#")]
            if not any(OUT.match(l) for l in lines): continue
            blocks += 1
            if "set -euo pipefail" in block:
                scripts += 1
                if not ("bash -n" in text and re.search(r"bash \.claude/local/scripts/[a-zA-Z<>_-]+\.sh", text)):
                    bad.append(rel + ":script-not-checked-or-not-handed")
            elif len(lines) != 1:
                bad.append(rel + ":%d-commands-in-one-block" % len(lines))
print("blocks=%d scripts=%d bad=%s" % (blocks, scripts, ",".join(bad) or "none"))
PY
); rc=$?; m=''; [ "$rc" = "0" ] || m="$m rc=$rc"; printf %s "$out" | grep -qF -- 'bad=none' || m="$m missing:bad=none"; if [ -z "$m" ]; then printf ok; else printf 'MISMATCH%s\n%s' "$m" "$out"; fi
